gate_a: PASS: archived actual physical traces and fixed source/input hashes verified
limitations: Terminal unit arrays are not archived. Recorded energy totals are assumed correct and checked for tie-break priority and winner consistency; they cannot be independently summed from units.
State and observation contents are opaque hashes. Their frame inclusion, equality, and continuity are verified; the hashes cannot be recalculated from unarchived raw objects.

Only the selected unit Q row is archived. Its legal top-two ranking, gap, and tie rule are checked, but smallest gap across all units and first eligible step cannot be reconstructed from these artifacts.

No policy/model execution, engine resimulation, or test suite was run. Caught-error absence, frozen tensor checks, public-feature provenance, and environment generation rely on frozen reviewed source plus successful complete manifests.
These are historical development keys; counterfactual current-match flips are not independent performance evidence or attainable additive full-game wins.
Failed deepcopy snapshot data are excluded entirely.
